# Aura — Website copy inventory

Extraction only. No copy has been audited, rewritten, translated or implemented.

Baseline: `46319c89de23f55c6baed6e8ae1886c911da4e90` · Branch: `codex/website-copy-audit`

## How to read this inventory

One unique ID per source/page/section occurrence or reference-library item. Repeated wording retains separate entries linked through duplicate_of. Counts are not counts of distinct phrases.

Expected/conditional refers only to local configuration, never verified live visibility. Unknown Admin values are null with explicit placeholders. Disabled sections and non-live defaults are appendices.

Preserve every source string verbatim, including English, mistakes, entities, HTML and interpolation expressions; no translation.

Preset values use schema default with subtype preset; CSS-generated words use hardcoded Liquid with subtype CSS-generated because requested source enum has no CSS category.

AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and landing-pages.md inspected for implementation context only. No documentation wording is presented as current storefront text; source code/templates win. No local paths are copied.

Every entry preserves the exact stored text in the **Exact copy** block. HTML is intentional; `display_text` in JSON provides the unescaped text view. JavaScript literal fragments keep their complete assembly expression. `null` means unavailable/dynamic text, never a proposed replacement. Setting order follows render-reference order where available; section positions follow the saved JSON `order` array.

## Unavailable content and extraction boundaries

- No Shopify Admin, live theme, dev server or remote media accessed.
- Template assignment, current live configuration, products, policies, menus, media transcripts and third-party injected text are not verifiable from local files.
- Liquid expressions, conditional blocks and client-generated copy are recorded with runtime conditions rather than fabricated resolved sentences.
- Native browser validation and Shopify-hosted checkout text are external.
- French locale selection is assumed only for referenced French translations; all unused locale keys and editor-only labels are excluded from storefront entry counts.
- Near-duplicate links are conservative string similarity candidates, not editorial judgments.
